newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada leading indicator rises 0.5 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Canada leading indicator rises 0.5 pct in Sept.

text.p: The Canadian composite leading indicator rose 0.5 percent in September to 180.6 (base 1981), Statistics Canada said on Wednesday.

The indicator foreshadows economic activity by tabulating figures for sectors that rise or fall in advance of broader movements in the economy. The figure is "smoothed", reflecting a moving average of approximately the past five months.
The unsmoothed index, reflecting the past month only, rose 0.7 percent in the month to 183.0.
